title: How to Cancel Tinder — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Tinder Gold, Plus, or Platinum subscription. Stop the monthly charge on iPhone or Android. Deleting the app doesn't cancel billing.
intro: Deleting Tinder does NOT cancel your subscription — you'll keep getting charged. You must cancel through Apple or Google's subscription settings. Here's exactly how.

steps.title: Do NOT just delete the app
steps.text: Uninstalling Tinder does not stop billing. Your subscription is managed by Apple App Store or Google Play, not the app itself.
steps.tip: This is the #1 mistake people make. They delete the app and continue being charged for months.

steps.title: Cancel through your app store
steps.text: iPhone: Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions → Tinder → Cancel. Android: Google Play Store → Menu → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → Tinder → Cancel.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Tap "Confirm" or "Cancel Subscription". Your premium features (unlimited likes, Super Likes, Passport, etc.) remain active until the billing period ends.

steps.title: Optionally delete your profile
steps.text: If you want to remove your profile entirely: Open Tinder → Settings → Delete Account. This is separate from canceling the subscription.
steps.tip: You can cancel the subscription but keep your profile active on the free tier if you want.

warnings: DELETING THE APP DOES NOT CANCEL YOUR SUBSCRIPTION. You must cancel through Apple/Google.
If you subscribed on tinder.com (web), cancel through tinder.com/app/settings instead.
Deleting your Tinder account is separate from canceling payment — do both if you're done with the service.
Free Tinder still works for swiping — you just get limited likes per day and no premium features.

faqs.q: Will I still be charged if I delete the Tinder app?
faqs.a: YES. Deleting the app does not stop your subscription. You must cancel through Apple Settings or Google Play to stop being charged.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Tinder?
faqs.a: Request refunds through Apple (reportaproblem.apple.com) or Google Play. Tinder itself rarely offers direct refunds. Act within a few days of the charge for best results.

faqs.q: What's the difference between canceling and deleting my account?
faqs.a: Canceling stops payment but keeps your profile. Deleting your account removes your profile, matches, and messages permanently. You can do either or both.

faqs.q: Can I use Tinder for free?
faqs.a: Yes. Free Tinder gives you limited right swipes per day, no Super Likes or Boosts, and no Passport feature. Basic matching still works.

refund.details: Refunds must go through Apple (reportaproblem.apple.com) or Google Play. Tinder doesn't process refunds directly. Request within a few days of charge for best results.

retentionTactics: Tinder doesn't have a traditional retention flow — cancellation is handled entirely by Apple/Google.
They may send push notifications about matches or new features after canceling.
